duplicatePolicy: No required unique evidence deleted. Historical crops are original-hash-verified usable receipts, not fabricated new runs. Timeout broad-mask and readable-mask variants retained; readable image is authoritative for error text.
review: Text patterns plus manual actual-image review; no raw email/UID/token/credentials/PDF/Base64 intended in added evidence. Not a repository-history purge. Existing large historical PR3 audit retained.
bytePolicy: Scoped .gitattributes freezes exact evidence bytes; manifest includes nested historical manifest and excludes only itself
